title: VanillaKush
description: A Modpack that aims to enhance everything from the UI, QOL, sounds, building, structures, biomes and plenty more.
body:
**This mod Pack is made up with 146 mods**

A collection of mods that enhance every aspect of Minecraft, while keeping the vanilla feel.

**POLISHED UI**

Plenty of mods enhance the UI, adding animations to opening and closing the inventory, moving items, smoothly scrolling inventories and plenty more.

**EXPLORE**

Explorify adds plenty of new structures in the vanilla style like campsites, dark forest settlements and taverns. and Hearths which enhance the biomes, structures and nether biomes respectively.

**Q.O.L** 

AutomaticSorter, BetterAnvils, EasyMagic, EasyShulkerBoxes, BiggerEnderChest, We also have leaves be gone, the bridging mod & better than mending.

**PERFORMANCE**

Countless mods improve performance in almost every way possible from world generation and entity culling to memory usage and even the rendering of text in game.

**Mods that require a link in description:**

Falling leaves - [https://modrinth.com/mod/fallingleaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/fallingleaves)

No Enchantment Cap Level - [https://modrinth.com/mod/no-enchantment-cap-level](https://modrinth.com/project/WFqyBJrO) / https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/no-enchantment-cap-level
